name: claude-malformed-output
description: Misbehavior (test-plan §1): malformed output. After a valid system-init line the agent emits a line that is not valid JSON at all (a truncated object), then a stray non-JSON line. The consumer's stream parser must survive garbage without crashing the session. emit_raw writes bytes verbatim (no framing, no validation); run without --validate.

steps.emit_raw: not json at all — just a stray line the parser must skip
